sloka: मिथ्या प्रव्राजितः रामः सभार्यः सह लक्ष्मणः ।भरते सम्निषृष्टाः स्मः सौनिके पशवो यथा ॥२-४८-२८॥
transliteration: mithyā pravrājitaḥ rāmaḥ sabhāryaḥ saha lakṣmaṇaḥ ।bharate samniṣṛṣṭāḥ smaḥ saunike paśavo yathā ॥2-48-28॥

translations.english: Rama along with Sita and Lakshmana has been deceitfully exiled and all of us delivered to Bharata like beasts to a butcher (for protection).
